Companion Animal Travel Desk Notice

Travelers must confirm pet papers, carrier condition, and check-in details before arrival.

Aurelia Skyways keeps companion travel under steady review, and the cabin team monitors animals during flight. <<FACT F009>> Follow staff direction without argument, keep the animal calm, and report any change in behavior at once. If a pet needs closer observation, the review process stays orderly and direct.

Use the quarantine room only when our staff advises it, and keep all items labeled and secure. <<FACT F027>> Clean bedding, proper ventilation, and quiet handling remain essential. Do not open enclosures without permission, and do not remove any pet from care procedures once the review has begun.

For Thornwick service, lounge handling remains under local control. <<FACT F004>> Travelers should speak plainly, arrive prepared, and avoid loose carriers or unsafe fittings. The desk will correct the next step if the record is incomplete.

Please go to the Companion Animal Travel Desk for final guidance.
